step1_callerIdentification.description: Agent must collect cardholder's full name, billing address, and last four digits of card number before proceeding.

step2_cardVerification.description: Full card number, expiration date, and billing ZIP code are collected and submitted for real-time authorization.

step3_authorizationCheck.description: Transaction must receive an authorization response code of '00' (Approved) before order is confirmed to caller.

step4_orderConfirmation.description: Agent reads back order details including item description, quantity, total amount, and shipping address to caller for verbal confirmation.

step5_emailConfirmation.description: Automated order confirmation email sent to the email address provided by the caller within 5 minutes of order completion.

callRecordingPolicy.note: Call recording was not active at the time of this transaction. Following this dispute, call recording has been implemented for all MOTO transactions effective April 2026.
callRecordingPolicy.newProcedure: All inbound and outbound sales calls are now recorded with automatic retention for 180 days.

additionalSafeguards: Velocity check: maximum 2 orders per card per 24-hour period
Address verification: shipping address must match billing address unless override is approved by supervisor
High-value orders (over $200): require supervisor approval and callback verification to cardholder's phone on file
